events.title: Table-topping 번리 drop their first points of the season by drawing 3–3 with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 . Elsewhere in the top-flight, 입스위치 타운 rack up a fifth win in a row by beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 4–1, 토트넘 홋스퍼 play out a goalless draw at 셰필드 웬즈데이 , 버밍엄 시티 put four without reply past 웨스트햄 유나이티드 , who slump into fifth, below both 입스위치 타운 and Spurs. In the rest of the Football League, 리버풀 are seven points clear of 스컨소프 유나이티드 at the top of the Second Division, South Coast clubs 본머스 & Boscombe Athletic and 포츠머스 lead Division Three, and Welsh club 렉섬 , who have recorded 14 wins already this season, are top of the Fourth Division.

events.text: 연도만 확인된 역사적 이적입니다. 정확한 이적일을 만들지 않고 연말부터 공개합니다.

events.title: 입스위치 타운 beat 아스널 3–0 and 번리 are held by 블랙번 로버스 in the East Lancashire derby , giving Town a two-point lead over 번리 at the top of Division One. In the race to evade joining already-relegated 첼시 in next season's second-tier, 카디프 시티 pick up a useful win against 웨스트햄 유나이티드, while fellow strugglers 풀럼 were beaten by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 . Both Cardiff and 풀럼 are on 31 points, but the West Londoners have one game more left to play compared with the Bluebirds. In the Second Division, 레이턴 오리엔트 's win over 루턴 타운 ensures the East London club continue to chase Scunthorpe and 선덜랜드 for the last remaining promotion spot.

events.title: 입스위치 타운, in the First Division for the first time, are crowned champions of English club football with a 2–0 win at home 애스턴 빌라 on the last day of the league season. It is the first major trophy of their history, and the first time that an English club has won the title in their first season as a top division club.
